name: Spherical Harmonics Raycaster (Shell Density)
definition: A volumetric raycasting method that renders a shell-shaped density field defined by spherical harmonics (specifically Y_l3_m0), using additive color accumulation, normalization, and saturation-based early termination.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Raycaster (Shell Density) renders a shell-shaped density field using the Y_l3,m0 harmonic, distinguishing itself by employing a binary shell thickness model instead of continuous gradients.
